parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Configuration page to obtain the workspace ID. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace for the API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Configuration page to obtain the workspace name. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace for the API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间名称。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The full path of the folder to be created, separated by forward slashes (/). To create a subfolder under a category directory in a workflow, you can call the ListFolders operation of the same version to query existing directories in the same workspace, use the returned Data.Folders[].FolderPath as the parent directory path, and then append a forward slash (/) and the new folder name. Example: Business_process/System_Data/MaxCompute/import_layer
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的文件夹完整路径，使用 `/` 分隔。在业务流程的类别目录下创建子文件夹时，可用同版本的 `ListFolders` 查询同一工作空间内已有的目录，取返回的 `Data.Folders[].FolderPath` 作为父目录路径，再追加 `/` 和新文件夹名称。例如 `Business_process/System_Data/MaxCompute/import_layer`
parameters.name: folder_path

Data.description_en: The unique identifier of the newly created folder
Data.description_zh: 新建文件夹的唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues when an error occurs

取值如下：
